titles.title: submit-turn posts each TurnEvent INCREMENTALLY (deltas observable before done)
single-in-flight: a second submit waits for the first, which reports to its end — no interleave; the first is not killed (H1/M2)
new-chat mid-stream stops the prior turn (no cross-session post) (M3)
malformed submit-turn (non-string text) is a no-op, no unhandled rejection (M4)
an errored turn persists its transcript rows (L3)
empty/whitespace submit-turn is a no-op (no run)
a terminal error TurnEvent is posted inline; unknown-provider is surfaced, not thrown
onDidDispose cancels the active turn and stops posting further
unknown / edit-* / docs-* inbound messages are accepted-but-ignored no-ops
no provider installed: open posts an error notice (no crash)
rendered shell: one nonce'd inline script + strict CSP + sc1 style + no remote origin
rendered shell mints a FRESH nonce per render
S004 rendered shell: non-delta turn-events route through the marker mapper (sc1 class, not the bare bracket)
S004 integration: a status->tool-call(mcp)->status->file-edit->done turn posts a marker per event and persists status+done rows (ac1/ac2, k8)
S001 (ux polish): a tool-result event persists a STRUCTURED role:tool-result row (command+output), never a marker
S001 (ux polish): a turn with NO tool-result events persists a byte-identical transcript (no tool-result rows)
S005 shell: provider-selector options == available + history-dropdown; one script + CSP intact
S005 shell: empty providers.available -> disabled selector
S005 open() posts a history-list
open()/close leaves NO empty session in history — the chat opens a draft, persisted only on first turn
LLM titling: the first turn swaps the truncated-prompt title for the LLM-derived name (+ refreshes history)
LLM titling: a failed/empty derivation keeps the truncated-prompt fallback
LLM titling: with no deriveTitle injected, the truncated-prompt fallback is kept (no built-in CLI call)
S005 new-chat: valid provider creates a fixed-provider session + re-posts history; non-available is a no-op
S005 open-chat: restores a prior transcript; a missing id is a no-op + refreshes history
S005 ac3 native resume: turn 2 carries resume from turn 1 done.sessionId; only the new prompt is sent
S005 switching chat mid-stream cancels the in-flight turn (single-in-flight preserved)
S005 a first-turn error still refreshes the history dropdown (title label)
S008 integration: a turn persists each marker row with cssClass === markerFor(ev).cssClass (ac2); assistant rows carry none
S008 integration: open-chat restore posts marker rows carrying their cssClass (ac1)
S001 shell: session-restored replay routes through the sc1 registry (keyed, single-sourced, carries the stored class); CSP/one-script/textContent intact

diff sections: an added section is pushed as a diff row with a sid and posted as transcript-row with its row index; an update and a withdraw are pushed as rows that name that sid, and no earlier row is changed
diff sections: a check is requested after every tool-result and file-edit event and once more at the end of the turn, and the session is saved after late rows
diff sections: overflow and unreadable push one marker row each and post it as transcript-row
diff sections: with no snapshot, or with the editor view, no diff state is made and the rows and messages are those of today
diff sections: the restored window and an older page carry each section's latest version at its first row's place
diff sections: while the diff state is open the file-edit marker and the successful edit result write no row, and a failed edit pushes and posts the path marker then the error row

diff sections: an edit whose path has no section after its check gets its path marker, posted as transcript-row, for a claude result, for a codex applied file-edit and at the end of the turn; an edit whose path has a section gets none
diff sections: a chat switch in mid-turn settles the held paths, saves, abandons the governor's turn before the detach, and a check in flight then pushes and posts nothing
diff sections: the Stop control, a newer turn's start, a sink error and closing the panel each end the open diff state and settle its held paths
diff sections: a followed turn writes and posts its rows as today and asks for no check, also while the governor still holds a snapshot
S006 integration: set-edit-mode updates + persists session.editMode
S006: without editGovernance the host behaves as before (no transcript-row; file-edit marker still renders)
S006 shell: edit-mode toggle + diff renderer live inside the ONE nonce'd script; CSP/textContent invariants intact
S001 ac1: submit-turn posts a live user-row (the prompt appears during the turn, not only on reload)
S001 lc1: two identical prompts yield two distinct-keyed live user-rows
S002 ac2: a cancel-turn message cancels the in-flight turn (cancelActive -> provider.cancel)
S002: a cancel-turn with no active turn is an idempotent no-op (no throw)
S002 (ux-polish) ac1/ac2/t3: the leading ">" prompt (#insrc-prompt) is the send/stop control; the trailing #insrc-send button is retired
S001 (74bc0120) ac5: the session dropdown cap doubles to 36ch; the rest of the chip is untouched
S001 (74bc0120) ac4: the no-CLI capability gate is the sole render-time disable and still wins
S001 (74bc0120) ac1/ac2/ac3: the lock starts closed and is settled at all three session transitions
S001 (74bc0120) regression: the lock is additive — the surrounding handlers are unchanged
both message bubbles span the full row (100%) and the assistant carries no magenta left rail; wrapper stays 100%
S002 ac1: the fixed-region layout holds — #insrc-term is the only scroll region; header + input stay flex:0
S001 (bugfix): the <body> carries no surface class — so .insrc-term-<surface>{display:block} cannot override body{display:flex} and collapse the flex-fill
S002 ac1/k1: all pre-existing element ids remain; one inline script; no innerHTML/remote origin
S002: an empty submit is a host no-op (no turn starts)
S002 ac3: renderShell embeds a single #insrc-progress widget above the input, not hidden and starting idle
S002 ac3/lc1: status events are never persisted to the durable transcript (host skip unchanged)
S003 t1: renderShell embeds the role-tone + markdown/JSON widget + caption CSS (inline, CSP-safe)
S001 (bugfix): renderShell has the SINGLE merged mode control + wires the approval seams
S001 (fidelity) ac1: the input is a FLUSH 2-line prompt — #insrc-input has no box chrome, rows=2 kept, ❯ top-aligned
S001 (fidelity) ac2: the placeholder gains the interrupt hint
ISSUE-6ae99f6e: the header holds ONLY the session dropdown; the provider + mode selects live in the footer status bar
UI: the #insrc-history session dropdown carries a leading history/clock glyph so its purpose reads
ISSUE-095906bac5bbacaf: every image source the shell DECLARES is permitted by its own CSP (a declared-but-blocked icon must fail)
S001 (fidelity) ac4 (regression): the S002 send/stop control + mode/provider switching are unchanged
S001 (bugfix): a turn's mode defaults to manual; set-permission-mode switches the NEXT turn (edit-auto / auto)
S001 (bugfix): an invalid set-permission-mode is dropped (mode unchanged)
S004 t7: permission-decision is relayed to the live turn adapter.decide with (turnId, requestId, decision)
S004 t7: permission-decision with no active turn is a safe no-op (never throws)
S001 adopt(channel) wires + posts theme/session-restored/history-list (restored panel shows history)
S001 adopt() supersedes an already-live channel (prior disposed; single active channel)
S001 adopt() with no agentic CLI posts the same error a fresh open does
S001 the webview posts a ready handshake AFTER attaching its message listener (initial load + every reload)
S001 a ready message (re)posts theme + active session + history — a reloaded webview repopulates
S001 ready before any open-time delivery still populates history (models the dropped initial post)
S001 (bugfix): approving a permission-denied request re-runs the blocked action with the tool pre-allowed, resuming the session
S001 (bugfix): denying a permission-denied request does NOT re-run (the turn stays denied)
S001 (bugfix): Approve on a tool-gate WITH a command re-runs naming the EXACT command (not the vague nudge) + pre-allows the tool
S001 (bugfix): Approve on a tool-gate WITHOUT a command falls back to the tool-name phrasing (+ allowedTools)
S001 (bugfix): Approve on a dir-block does NOT re-run/grant — it posts an informational message; argv/allowlist untouched
S001 (bugfix) + S003 (ux polish): Deny drops both a tool-gate and a dir-block — no re-run; posts ONLY the rejected outcome chip
S001 (bugfix): an in-turn request is relayed to adapter.decide (codex/in-turn relay); an id the host does not hold still falls through
S003 ac2: approving a tool-gate WITH a command re-runs with [toolName] but posts ZERO user-row echoes (suppressEcho)
S003 ac2: a NORMAL user turn still posts its user-row echo (suppressEcho gates ONLY the synthetic grant re-run)
S003 ac2: the tool-name FALLBACK grant (no command) also suppresses the echo + records the approved outcome
S003 ac3: a dir-block Approve records an approved outcome (even though it does NOT re-run)
S003 ac4: after an approve, the persisted transcript carries the outcome row and NO approval-request (the pending card never replays)
S001 (bugfix): set-permission-mode persists onto the active (saved) session
S001 (bugfix): the mode FOLLOWS the session — opening a chat adopts its persisted mode
S001 (bugfix): the webview sets the mode control from a restored session
S004 (ux polish): renderShell wires the selection decision sink + routes selection turn-events (approval path intact)
S004 (ux polish): a selection-decision records the outcome (chosen LABELS) AND continues the run via a synthesized user turn
S004 (ux polish): a selection-decision for an unknown/stale requestId is a safe no-op (no outcome, no run)
S004 (ux polish): a selection-decision with an empty/invalid selected list is dropped (no outcome, no run)
a message sent while the previous CLI process is still alive after its answer waits, shows 'Waiting for the previous turn to finish', and starts only after that process exits
with a short timeout, the still-running holder is stopped and the new turn starts after its exit is confirmed
Stop ends the running process at once and the waiting message then runs; with the queue every message runs, in order, one answer each
a lock failure other than a dropped wait is logged and shown, never a silent no-op
a turn whose adapter fails to start releases the session lease (the next turn does not wait)
a turn records its cursor on the session as lines are handled and clears it at the terminal event
after a reload (a new host over the same store) a session with a live cursor is followed from the saved offset, only new events are posted and appended, and the cursor is cleared at the end
a cursor whose generation is gone (rolled over twice) is cleared without resuming
a second live window that is not the cursor's owner does not follow it; once the owner host is gone it takes over
switching chat or closing the panel stops following a turn writing to the session file without stopping its process, and showing the session again resumes it; a turn without one is still stopped
Stop ends a resumed turn's process through the handle resume() hands over
closing the panel mid-turn leaves a session-file turn running with its cursor saved
a failing store save or a failing process stop never becomes an unhandled rejection
a save failing at the end of a turn is logged; the turn still ends cleanly and the history is refreshed
a save failing while the derived title is stored is logged, never an unhandled rejection, and the history is still refreshed
a failing save of a selection or permission outcome is logged and the run still continues
a failing edit-governor call is logged, never an unhandled rejection
three requests in one turn: only the first card is posted (with '1 of 3')
a turn followed after reload routes its approval-requests through the queue and its end ends the batch
Stop with requests queued records each as rejected and clears the queue
outcome rows: one role:'permission-outcome' row per decision, in decision order, and no approval-request rows (restore shows only chips)
the second card is posted only after the first is decided; a decision on a waiting card's id does nothing
live-turn provider with two requests: decide() is called for the first before the second card is posted; no follow-up turn is started
an in-turn request that carries a toolName is relayed with decide(), not batched (routing by resolution)
approving all three starts exactly one follow-up turn, after the last decision and the turn's end, with allowedTools = all three tools and a prompt naming the three approved actions
no approval ever supersedes a running follow-up: turns.start is called once per batch
deny: a denied request gets a rejected chip, the next request is still asked, and the follow-up names it as denied; all denied -> no follow-up and an informational message
a follow-up that is refused again forms the next batch and its follow-up carries the previous batch's grants
a user-typed message while requests are queued records each as rejected, clears the queue, resets the grant chain and runs as a normal turn
a live provider with a queued in-turn request, then the user types a message: decide(turnId, requestId, 'deny') is called before the new turn starts, and the request gets a rejected chip
a request joining the queue while the head is shown updates the shown card in place (one card per requestId)
reloading the webview while requests are queued re-posts the head card, and deciding it continues the queue

live rows carry rowIndex from all five writers: assistant, marker and tool-result events, the user-row, a permission outcome and a selection outcome are each posted with the absolute index of the row already written; status and approval-request carry none
write-then-post order: when each live row is posted, the transcript already holds it at that index
a followed turn writes each row before posting it; after a chat switch the follow stops, posting and writing nothing more; the write is outside the shown-session guard
load-older for the active session answers one transcript-page whose rows end just before `before`; repeated requests walk back to index 0
load-older for another session id, or with a malformed before or sessionId, posts nothing
session-restored carries firstIndex 0 and total while the whole transcript is still sent

the shell embeds the pager: line() appends through it, session-restored replays with absolute keys through its reset, transcript-page goes to prepend, live rows are stamped and trimmed, and the provider lock settles from total
the shell is still one nonce'd inline script, with no direct scrollTop write outside the pager, no innerHTML outside the guarded markdown path and no remote origin
opening a 1,000-row session posts session-restored with at most 200 rows, firstIndex at a turn start, total 1,000 and the session's mode; a short session is posted whole with firstIndex 0
ready, new-chat and open-chat post the same windowed session-restored
a ready after older pages were requested posts the latest window again, with the approval head after it
the stored session is unchanged by paging: after restores and page loads the saved transcript equals the original rows
the chat panel run over the file store: a turn's saves append only that turn's rows, a restored session shows the same rows, and a failing save is logged without breaking the turn

host: attach-image and pick-attachments add to the active session's pending list and post attachments-pending; remove-attachment removes one; errors are posted as one sentence and the list is unchanged

host: ready, new-chat and open-chat post each session's own pending list; an unknown or foreign attachment id in remove or open does nothing; open-attachment opens the resolved path of a row's or a pending attachment
host without the attachments seams: the shell has no attach button or chip row and the four messages are ignored
host: an attach-image whose base64 length implies more than the limit is refused without decoding and without calling the store
host: a dismissed dialog posts nothing, and a pick over the limit keeps the first ten and posts one error sentence

host: a submit stores the user's text with the attachments on the row, echoes them on user-row, sends a prompt that ends with the attached-files block of absolute paths, passes readDirs, and clears the pending list
host: a submit with blank text and an attachment runs a turn and names the chat from the attachment; with blank text and none it is a no-op
host: a submit waits for an attachment still being written, and the message carries every chip in order
host: a later turn of a session with an attachment still passes readDirs, a session with none passes none, and a grant re-run keeps it
host: a grant re-run and a selection continuation leave the pending list untouched and attach nothing
host: a submit with blank text and an attachment supersedes queued approvals
host: with the queue, a submit with blank text and an attachment leaves the waiting cards as they are, waits, and runs once they are decided
host: a chat switch while a submit waits drops the submit and keeps the chips on their session, and a second submit runs after the first

chat host: a run turn begins a presenter turn just before it starts, passes each tool result that is not an error, and ends it once when the run is over, also for a turn that failed, was stopped or was superseded; a message refused before any run begins none; a presenter that throws does not disturb the turn

chat host: a followed turn begins a presenter turn on its first event, not when the follow is asked for, passes its tool results and ends it when the follow ended; a ready message during a run turn begins nothing, and the run turn's end still opens a newly pending document
chat host: a turn followed by a second message still passes its tool results to the presenter, which opens the document it presents, once
chat host: submitExternal in a window without a queue answers unavailable with a note and keeps nothing

chat host: the queued turn runner shows the message's chat (opening the panel when it is closed), resolves only after a grant re-run continuation ends, resolves stopped when a waiting card gets no answer within the wait, resolves detached-ended only after a detached CLI exits and stopped for a pipe turn, resolves stopped when the turn is dropped before it starts (a chat switch during the session-lease wait), and fails a message whose chat no longer exists
a queued turn that ends with done ok:false resolves failed with the text, not done
a turn that emitted a tool-call, file-edit or tool-result before its error reports acted true; one that failed with none reports acted false with the classified cause
a claude is_error result with an overload text before any tool call is reported failed with the overload cause; the same after a file edit reports acted true
every failed turn's cause and error text are logged
a retried message is started with skipUserRow, so the stored transcript has a single user row after a retry while the prompt is still sent to the CLI
a retry stores and posts one retrying line, still in the stored transcript after a reload, and a turn that streamed only text before an infrastructure failure is retried and keeps its partial text
an auth failure stores and posts a sign-in line in the chat
a normal turn still pushes and echoes its user row exactly as before
the worker give-up note is shown live and is not stored in the transcript
a chat page rebuilt while a turn runs is told the turn is running, and one rebuilt when nothing runs is not

the shell script runs: a windowed restore shows one page at the bottom with the bar, a page request round-trips and keeps the reader's place, a live row does not move a reader who scrolled up, and an old-style restore still works
the shell script bounds the view of a long active session: rows past the limit are trimmed at the bottom and come back on request

shell script: the attach button posts pick-attachments, an image paste posts attach-image with its base64 and is prevented, a text paste is untouched, chips render from attachments-pending with a remove control, and a blank box with chips submits
shell: the attach button is icon-only with an aria-label, sits first in the status bar, and the content security policy is unchanged
shell script: a chip click on a sent message posts open-attachment, and the error sentence is shown and cleared

transcript-row: a diff row without replaces appends a widget stamped with its row index; one with replaces redraws the widget of that sid and keeps it open; a withdrawn one hides it; one for an unknown or trimmed sid changes nothing
transcript-row: a marker row appends the same line a restored marker row draws
diff widget: a diff row in a session-restored window and in a transcript-page is appended as a widget

chat shell: the outbox band is present only with the queue, and the queue hint replaces the input placeholder only with it; an outbox message draws its rows and summary and each action posts its seq; with the queue a submit does not mark the turn running
a retrying row shows 'attempt n of 3', a countdown, a retry-now button and a cancel button, and retry-now posts outbox-retry-now with its seq
chat shell: the progress widget is never hidden: idle at the start, working after turn-running, idle after done, error, Stop and session-restored
chat shell: an informational line's done does not end a running turn, and the turn's own done and error still do
